Done. Demonstrated orientation selectivity in mouse visual cortex using DANDI:000021 (Allen Institute Visual Coding Neuropixels).

**Outputs in `/Users/bdichter/dev/agent-foundational-studies/runs-2026-04-27/orientation-01/`:**
- `orientation_selectivity.py` — jupytext script (runs end-to-end)
- `orientation_selectivity.ipynb` — converted notebook
- `README.md` — dataset, methods, key findings
- `unit_metrics.csv` — per-unit OSI/DSI/gOSI/pref-direction/p-value
- `figures/01–08*.png` — raster, polar/Cartesian tuning curves for top 6 V1 units, population OSI/DSI/gOSI by area, preferred-direction histogram, aligned-tuning heatmap and population mean, ANOVA fraction tuned

**Key result:** ~82% of V1 units significantly orientation-tuned (ANOVA p<0.01); aligned V1 population tuning shows the textbook signature — peak at preferred direction, ~50% suppression at orthogonal (±90°), secondary peak at 180° (same orientation, opposite drift) — and individual cells reach OSI 0.95, DSI 0.64.
